description.en: [插件由AI生成]Fully customized function automation for OneBot v11 with visual tile-based workflow editor, covering Koishi status, JSON/XML tools, randomness, time, string hashing and array operations, with OneBot framework adaptation (LLOneBot/NapCat) and debug logging.
